prompt: 把季度运营数据做成结论先行的 HTML 报告，并生成桌面和移动截图。
baseline_output: 未记录；本次不主张 baseline 对比优势。
assertions: HTML audit exits 0 with no errors
desktop PNG exists and has PNG signature
mobile PNG exists and has PNG signature
report contains one h1, semantic main, units, source and limitations
report has no remote script, stylesheet, font or image dependency
human_notes: Desktop and mobile screenshots must be opened and checked for hierarchy, overflow, overlap and label readability.
Aesthetic superiority and statistical correctness are missing evidence without blind review and source-data recomputation.

chart_gallery_case.prompt: 整合开源图表库，生成包含多种有趣图表的响应式 HTML 图库和截图。
assertions: vendor SHA-256 and license checks pass
HTML is self-contained and has zero remote resources
13 of 13 chart containers have role/ARIA and figure captions
13 of 13 charts reach runtime ready state without captured errors
desktop and mobile full-page PNGs render without clipping
human_notes: Desktop and mobile gallery screenshots were opened; D3 chord overflow found in the first desktop pass was fixed by constraining SVG height to the chart container.
Independent preference testing and real-dataset statistical review remain missing evidence.

default_style_case.prompt: 按默认风格生成 HTML 报告，不指定额外主题。
assertions: default fixtures do not contain cream, green-red editorial, gradient, glass, or heavy-shadow defaults
Latin and CJK display leading use separate tokens; CJK defaults to 1.12 and never falls below 1.08
desktop and mobile multi-line Chinese titles have visible vertical breathing room without glyph collision
page shell remains monochrome while chart recipes expose a distinct multi-color data palette
chart color is reinforced by labels, line style, texture, shape, or ordering and is not the only encoding
global ECharts aria decal is disabled so default chart fills render as clean solid colors without automatic hatching
desktop and mobile screenshots are opened after restyling
